name: Forest Warden Omu
guide_text: Always think about your next turn! On turn 1, freeze a 2 cost spell so your turn 2 is much cleaner. Omu almost always levels to tavern 3 on turn 4 while buying a minion.
buddy_guide_text: Buddy up for 3-5 Gold. It'll give you value 1-2 turns but it's hard to scale so will probably not stay on your board past that.
